added_lines: . free hse information evening : learn about fair deal, enduring power of attorney, sage advocacy, & age friendly homes. talks begin at 8pm thursday, 22 october: meadowlands hotel, oakpark, tralee, v92 dc83. pope leo’s mission sunday message the mission of the disciples and the church as a whole is to continue the mission of christ in the holy spirit: a mission born of love, lived in love, and leading to love. guided by the holy spirit, the spirit of love, the church’s evangelizing mission will continue until the end of time. i would like to express my special gratitude to today’s ad gentes missionaries. despite adversity and human limitations, they continue to give themselves joyfully, because they know that christ himself, and his gospel, are the greatest treasures we can offer. we must always keep them close to our hearts and continually pray to the father for them. may he grant us the gift of young people and adults who are willing to leave everything behind to follow christ on the path of evangelization even to the ends of the earth! holy father, make us one in christ, rooted in his love that unites and renews. may all members of the church be united in mission, docile to the holy spirit, courageous in bearing witness to the gospel, proclaiming and daily embodying your faithful love for all creatures. bless all missionary men and women, support them in their efforts, and watch over them in hope! ministers of the eucharist keel 24th oct. john carmody & mary ita ladden kiltallagh 25th oct. miriam ryan & colm lynch readers keel 24th oct. family readers kiltallagh 25th oct. family readers altar society keel 24th oct. maura barton kiltallagh 25th oct. caroline lynch offertory collectors keel october pat flynn & eimear regan kiltallagh october james moriarty & gerry buckley castlemaine

*october is the month of the holy rosary: we will pray the holy rosary every evening at 7.00pm except for saturday evening when the rosary will be prayed at 6.10pm before the vigil mass and tuesday evenings 7.30pm. all are welcome to attend. *mission month: for the month of october, our diocese unites in prayer for those considering god’s call to the priesthood. it is among family that god calls pri ests to serve his people. we encourage anyone considering this vocation to contact our voc ations team –

*prayer meeting: please note a change to our weekly prayer meetings, they will be held on thursday mornings directly after 10am mass, in the nun’s chapel. we w ould like to invite everyone to join us and would especially like to encourage any musicians to bring their instruments, as this would beautifully enhance our prayers. everyone is welcome to jo in us for refreshments after. *mass for the deceased 2025/2026: we will celebrate the annual mass for the dead, on saturday 7th november at 6.30pm, where a candle will be lit for all those wh o dies during the past year. candles will also be lit to represent natives of the parish who died elsewhere, relatives of parishioners who dies elsewhere and those who have nobody to pray for them. please contact the office if you wish to add names to the list. prayer for vocations heavenly father, you call each of us by name and invite us to follow your son with generous hearts. pour out your holy spirit upon our diocese of kerry, that you ng people may encounter christ and have the courage to answer your call. raise up holy priests to proclaim your word, celebrate the eucharist with joy, and serve your people with humble love. strengthen those already called to be faith ful witnesses to the gospel. through the prayers of mary, mother of the church, and st. brendan, our patron saint, bless our diocese with joyful and generous vocations to the priest hood for the glory of your name and the life of the world. we ask this through christ our lord. amen god bless, fr. amos (
